title: Reweighting for Transfer Classification: Exact Risk Conversion and Minimax Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A source can make a training mixture easier to learn while making its accuracy less valuable for the target. We study how the training problem a source creates and the finite-sample error of learning it jointly determine target-risk guarantees under reweighting. For binary classification, for each pair of laws and each positive target weight, we derive the sharpest target excess hinge-risk bound implied by mixture excess alone, uniformly over clipped predictors. This exact conversion curve is determined by density-weighted local votes. A two-sample oracle inequality for weighted support vector machines supplies the mixture excess, and the composition becomes explicit for Gaussian kernels. On a tilted-boundary class, we establish the all-procedure minimax classification rate $[n+s_+^2/(m^{-1}+\tau^2)]^{-1}$ in the transferable strength $s_+$ and the tilt $\tau$, separating source sampling uncertainty ($m^{-1}$) from relation uncertainty

translated_title: 迁移分类的重加权：精确风险转换与极小极大自适应
translated_abstract: 一个源域可以让训练混合数据更容易学习，同时降低其准确性对目标域的价值。我们研究源域造成的训练问题以及学习它的有限样本误差如何共同决定重加权下的目标风险保证。对于二分类问题，针对每一对分布和每个正的目标权重，我们推导出仅由混合超额风险隐含的最尖锐的目标超额合页风险界，且该界在所有截断预测器上一致成立。这一精确转换曲线由密度加权的局部投票决定。加权支持向量机的两样本预言机不等式提供了混合超额风险的估计，而对于高斯核，两者的组合变得显式。在一个倾斜边界类上，我们建立了关于可迁移强度 $s_+$ 和倾斜度 $\tau$ 的统一极小极大分类率 $[n+s_+^2/(m^{-1}+\tau^2)]^{-1}$，将源采样不确定性 ($m^{-1}$) 与关系不确定性分离开来。
tldr: 本文推导出迁移分类中由混合超额风险到目标超额合页风险的精确转换曲线（由密度加权局部投票决定），并在倾斜边界类上建立了将源采样不确定性与关系不确定性分离的极小极大分类率。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the exact conversion curve from mixture excess to target excess hinge risk in transfer classification, determined by density-weighted local votes, and establishes the minimax classification rate on tilted-boundary classes that separates source sampling uncertainty from relation uncertainty.
